name: json-viewer

frames.render_note: All six frames show a "Preview unavailable" warning instead of the JSON tree.

tagline: Folds a raw JSON payload into a colour-coded tree with line numbers and copy.
summary: A bordered code panel that renders a JSON object as an indented tree. Keys and values are colour-coded by type, branches fold open, long arrays truncate, dates get a relative hint, and the header offers Expand All, Collapse All and Copy.
appearance: Every recorded frame is a near-black stage holding only a grey warning triangle above the words "Preview unavailable", centred in large grey type. The viewer itself, its border, title row and tree never appear.
behaviour: From the code, each object or array folds and unfolds on click, its chevron rotating as it opens; the header expands or collapses every branch and copies the payload, and arrays over five items hide behind a Show more button. The frames show none of this.
use_when: A dashboard or API tool must show a raw JSON response that people can fold, read and copy.
avoid_when: The recorded frames render as an error, so its real look is unverified; deep payloads mean a lot of nested rows.
customise: The data object, header title, default expansion depth, line numbers, colour indent, click or double-click collapse and array truncation are props. Colours and row styling are in the source.
weight_why: Renders only the open branches of the tree; no animation loop.

a11y.note: Expand and collapse sits on a clickable div, so only the chevron button is keyboard reachable, and it has no label or aria-expanded state.

issues: All six frames show a Preview unavailable error instead of the viewer.
The Expand All, Collapse All and Copy controls never appear in the frames.
polish_why: The recording is a broken preview, so the component itself cannot be judged from it.
title: JSON Viewer
